_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#10, confirmed by execution. Self-contained 2-D deck: a 6x6 pdphase plate with its left column at x=1.5 and a 6-particle boundaryphase wall at x=0.5, one PERIDYNAMIC_GRID_SPACING away, driven by a Dirichlet function whose only difference between the arms is the sign of the wall velocity. Retreating wall: the plate's edge particle ends at posx=1.5, velx=0 with abs(diff) exactly 0.00000000000000000e+00, and 'Number of pd_neighbor_pairs in peridynamic evaluation on this proc' peaks at 0 — no contact pair is ever created, because a pair only exists where the separation drops BELOW the grid spacing, so there is no tensile branch to reach. Advancing wall: pairs peak at 6 and the plate is accelerated. Same deck, same speed, opposite sign. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the contrast: drive the retreating arm INTO the plate as well. Both arms then push, the pull arm stops being exactly undisturbed, PULL_MAX_CONTACT_PAIRS stops being 0 and PULL_FAILURES becomes non-zero, so the fixture must go red.
